title: centaurea biebersteinii subsp. australis
intro: Centaurea biebersteinii subsp. australis, commonly known as the Australian knapweed or Centaurea australis, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea biebersteinii subsp. australis include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antiseptic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
